content.text:
is exactly 2-isomorphism (unconditional; uses S1743's section lift ∘ toSource
  ≅ id and S1742 2-Yoneda, not the missing retraction S1743SourceRetraction).
  S1766QuotAct_injective: the action is injective on the 2-iso quotient.
  S1766_raw_injective_iff_discrete: raw R2a is exactly S1766CoverMapDiscrete.
  S1766ActualCounterexample and S1766_not_injective_iff_actualCounterexample
  give the exact counterexample shape; the tree constructs no cover object, so
  no unconditional counterexample is asserted.  S1766QuotSmallCarrier (Type 0)
  with S1766QuotSmallEquiv is the correct small hom model (2-iso quotient, not
  raw maps); the commutes field is a subsingleton.
- Boundary: R2b/surjectivity and the Galois structure are untouched;
  target_accepted=false.  More test points cannot repair raw injectivity.
- Evidence: 670 lines, 30748 bytes,
  SHA256 CA8092D883E777A19FC41523D9D20FA624E551D88FF8D558C8E40B35139151E3;
  EXIT=0, no warnings, no sorryAx; olean 194168 bytes, SHA256
  9CF748968DE39426F17E2151767C9C1F5C2760227483E31FACC4B221F6A3E20C;
  axioms trio only.
- Ledger and queue updated; report
  coord/reports/S1766-canonical-model-injectivity-actual.md.


=====LEDGER TAIL=====
  `PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan (bc K).op` = pushout preservation; it does NOT follow
  from finite-limit preservation. Concretely it needs the coherence
  `Kbar ⊗[K] (B ⊗[A] C) ≃ₐ[Kbar] (Kbar ⊗[K] B) ⊗[Kbar ⊗[K] A] (Kbar ⊗[K] C)` compatible with
  the four canonical maps. Mathlib has no such statement; nearest are
  `Algebra.IsPushout.tensorProduct_tensorProduct` (the square `A → B`, `A → A ⊗[R] S`,
  `B → B ⊗[R] S` is a pushout), `IsPushout.cancelBaseChangeAlg` (`B ⊗[A] C ≃ₐ[S] S ⊗[R] C`
  when `B = S ⊗[R] A`) and `Algebra.IsPushout.comp_iff` (cancellation of a left pushout square
  in a rectangle). Also available: S1745's `tensorCocone`/`tensorCocone_isColimit`, the closure
  of `CommAlgCat.finiteEtale K` under `WalkingSpan`-colimits, and
  `walkingCospanOpEquiv : WalkingCospanᵒᵖ ≌ WalkingSpan`.
- Reusable pitfalls: (1) morphisms of `ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory` are wrappers
  `{ hom : X.obj ⟶ Y.obj }`, so `CommAlgCat.ofHom` does not elaborate to a full-subcategory
  morphism; use `ObjectProperty.homMk`. (2) `CommAlgCat.of R ↑X` and a stored
  `X : CommAlgCat R` are not always definitionally equal (instance terms differ), so prefer
  `FiniteEtale.ofHom` when the instances are in scope, and keep all constructions on one
  `FiniteEtale.of`-normal form. (3) `Algebra.TensorProduct.ext` takes the two composites with
  `includeLeft`/`includeRight`; for the pointwise `forall a b, f (a ⊗ b) = g (a ⊗ b)` form use
  `Algebra.TensorProduct.ext'`. (4) `[Finite G]` does not yield `Fintype G` by typeclass
  search; add `letI : Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G`. (5) `Fork.IsLimit.mk` elaborates the
  lift before the side goals; introduce the cone variable with `intro s` in each goal rather
  than closing the lift's side condition inside the lambda.
- Environment note: many concurrent lake/lean processes; intermittent
  "failed to read file ...olean" errors occurred on this shared workspace, all final builds
  succeeded on retry.
